nodes.label:
Financial Event
Occurs
nodes.title: Financial Event Occurs
nodes.info: A mentor spends money, a family donates, or a grant cheque arrives -- the trigger for every step that follows.

nodes.label:
Expense or
Donation?
nodes.title: Expense or Donation?
nodes.info: The two paths differ: an expense needs reimbursement, a donation needs a receipt.

nodes.label:
Mentor Files
Expense Report
nodes.title: Mentor Files Expense Report
nodes.info: Date, amount, category, and an attached receipt or photo of one. The photo is the step mentors skip and the one an approver cannot proceed without.

nodes.label:
Checked Against
Reimbursement Policy
nodes.title: Checked Against Reimbursement Policy
nodes.info: The approver confirms the expense is reimbursable, within the submission window, and under any approval threshold.

nodes.label: Reimbursement Paid
nodes.title: Reimbursement Paid
nodes.info: Payment issued to the mentor, and the amount logged in the budget tracking spreadsheet against its matching category.

nodes.label:
Donation Logged
and Receipted
nodes.title: Donation Logged and Receipted
nodes.info: Donor name, amount or item, date, and a written acknowledgment provided. The acknowledgment is not a courtesy -- for many donors it is a tax document.

nodes.label:
Recorded in Tracking
Spreadsheet
nodes.title: Recorded in Tracking Spreadsheet
nodes.info: Income row added, categorised to match the funding source it came from.

nodes.label:
Rolled Into Annual
Budget Review
nodes.title: Rolled Into Annual Budget Review
nodes.info: Every expense and every donation recorded this way becomes the actual-spending data the annual budget review compares against the original budget.
